mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the threads to the platelet plug was most worthwhile: it showed how the mesh reinforces the plug to stop bleeding.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the threads was a little less engaging because it was the only offered combination, although the picture made their purpose clear.

surprise.text: The vessel was sealed while the skin above it remained open; stopping bleeding and healing the skin are different stages.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The enzyme label explained the thread-making pair, though it was also the only offered combination at that point.

continue.text: Yes. I'd like to see how the still-open skin heals after the bleeding stops.
